title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLMs
intervention_exposure: On-policy self-distillation; teacher is the same model given verified solutions as privileged information.
results: Matches GRPO with significantly improved token efficiency; no single multiplier stated in the full text.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?
population: Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B, Olmo3-7B-Instruct on math reasoning.
results: Shorter responses, math performance down by up to 40 %, uncertainty expression suppressed.
study_design: Analysis paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Sampled Demonstrations Reduces Output Diversity
population: Graph path-finding and science QA, not mathematics.
results: Rollout diversity decreases and pass@k curves flatten.
study_design: Empirical analysis, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Anti-Self-Distillation (AntiSD) via Pointwise Mutual Information
intervention_exposure: Entropy-gated PMI term against PI-induced teacher bias.
results: Up to 11.5 points over GRPO with 2 to 10x fewer training steps.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: AMR-SD: Asymmetric Meta-Reflective Self-Distillation for Token-Level Credit Assignment
intervention_exposure: Meta-reflective self-distillation with temporal annealing and token-level advantage modulation.
results: Raw oracle solutions linked to answer leakage and late-stage collapse.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
intervention_exposure: Position-weighted OPSD with clipped forward-KL target.
comparator: Standard OPSD with uniform token weights.
results: Position score AUROC 0.83 versus at most 0.57 for local uncertainty; Avg@12 +1.0 and +1.1.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation of Language Models
population: Qwen3-0.6B, 1.7B, 4B-Base on six math benchmarks; external teacher.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only; not a privileged self-teacher.

title: beta-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
intervention_exposure: Family interpolating between reference policy and privileged teacher, with return-to-go credit.
results: Outperforms vanilla OPSD on mathematical benchmarks.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient
intervention_exposure: Policy-gradient hybrid with verifier advantages, reverse KL to teacher and reference KL.
results: Better stability and performance; models and data not named in abstract.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: HDPO: Hybrid Distillation Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation
intervention_exposure: Privileged self-distillation on prompts where all rollouts fail.
results: Pass@4 +0.8 to +1.1 %, pass@8 +0.4 to +1.7 %, greedy accuracy kept.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Rebellious Student: Reversing Teacher Signals (RLRT)
intervention_exposure: Reversing the teacher signal on correct rollouts.
results: Teacher mechanism overwrites student choices on successful rollouts.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation
intervention_exposure: Replacing the correct reference with a solution from another problem.
results: Correct reference gives no consistent benefit; another problem's solution can beat it.
study_design: Critique paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Privileged Solutions or Context-Induced Teacher Behavior? Dissecting On-Policy Self-Distillation
intervention_exposure: OP2SD: problem and solution from a different example.
results: Improves over base, competitive with OPSD; gains not necessarily from the reference solution.
study_design: Critique paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Is More Privileged Information Better? Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning
intervention_exposure: Trajectory-grounded guidance instead of full solution.
results: Highest aggregate question-only accuracy among compared methods.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation in LLM Reasoning
results: Avg@12 +0.95, +2.05 and +2.33; mismatch grows monotonically with exposure.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Understanding Diversity Collapse in RLVR via the Lens of Overtraining
population: RLVR on reasoning tasks, no teacher.
results: Pass@1 improves while high-k Pass@k degrades; zero-success-only updates lift Pass@256 above base.
study_design: Analysis paper, preprint; abstract read only.

title: Guidance Contrastive Token Credit Assignment for Discrete Policy Optimization
intervention_exposure: Contrast of predictions under positive and negative prompts.
results: Per-token credit assignment; not a privileged self-distillation method.
study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.
